faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Data Entry Operator post at AIIMS Gorakhpur?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Data Entry Operator position at AIIMS Gorakhpur is 01 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Data Entry Operator role?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the Intermediate or 12th grade from a recognized board and possess a fast typing speed, which will be assessed during the selection process.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Data Entry Operator position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Data Entry Operator post is 25 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Data Entry Operator position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 20,000.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Data Entry Operator recruitment at AIIMS Gorakhpur?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to send their completely filled application form via email to [email protected] by the last date.

faq.question: Q6. What documents do I need to bring for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should bring the duly filled application form, a recent photograph, CV/biodata, and self-attested copies of all relevant documents, along with originals for verification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Data Entry Operator role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Data Entry Operator position at AIIMS Gorakhpur will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What is the total number of vacancies for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Data Entry Operator post at AIIMS Gorakhpur.

faq.answer: AIIMS Gorakhpur is located in Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh.
